decisions.selected: Measure whether the workflow publishes a repository audit verdict for the fixed GitHub Next Agentic Workflows blog target.
alternatives: Measure token cost or trace quality
Ask an agent to judge audit quality
decisions.rationale: The adoption workflow explicitly described an automated monitor for a fixed blog URL and required reporting validation results; activity and agent judgment are not direct repository outcome evidence.

decisions.selected: One Monday-based UTC weekly opportunity for https://githubnext.com/projects/agentic-workflows/ based on run createdAt.
alternatives: Use each workflow run ID as a separate opportunity
Use all blog pages on githubnext.com as the opportunity set
decisions.rationale: The workflow is scheduled weekly against one exact target URL; weekly keys keep duplicate runs for the same target window clustered instead of treating reruns as independent opportunities.

decisions.selected: Derive opportunityKey from the target URL and the Monday UTC week containing run.createdAt, reconstructing the same key when case and event are null.
decisions.rationale: Historical report backfills may supply only the run subject; createdAt and the frozen target URL are sufficient to reconstruct a stable assignment without relying on archived case/event data.

decisions.selected: Accept only Audits discussions in github/gh-aw that reference the exact workflow run URL, target URL, required validation sections, and a recognized PASSED or FAILED verdict before cutoff.
alternatives: Use eval answers audit-completed or discussion-created
Fetch the live external blog page at grading time
decisions.rationale: The discussion is the durable repository-local artifact the workflow is instructed to publish, while evals, traces, and output counts are indirect activity signals and live page fetches cannot reconstruct historical outcomes.

decisions.selected: Cap evidence at min(evidenceAt, run.createdAt + 1 day).
alternatives: Treat the run as immediately final
Use an unbounded future evidence window
decisions.rationale: The workflow timeout is ten minutes and safe-output publication should be immediate, but a fixed one-day maturation window allows delayed publication while making mature observations stable.

decisions.selected: Primary value is binary: 1 for a matching recognized audit discussion, 0 for completed search with no match, null for unavailable or malformed evidence.
alternatives: Pass/fail state of the external page
decisions.rationale: The direct repository outcome is the presence of a usable published audit verdict for the assigned opportunity; partial section counts would be a diagnostic completeness score, output volume is activity, and external page state is not historically reconstructable from accepted evidence.

decisions.selected: Use attainment-only baseline with null value and null cutoff.
alternatives: Assume pre-adoption value 0 because the workflow did not exist
Use another workflow's discussion publication rate
decisions.rationale: The workflow was added in the adoption commit, and no comparable pre-adoption weekly blog-audit discussions under this contract were identified; missing comparable evidence is null, not zero.

uncertainties.description: The metric verifies a durable published verdict and required validation sections, but it does not independently replay the external page state at the historical run time.
GitHub Discussion search or body access may be unavailable to the grader token; those cases are reported as null rather than zero.
The observation records attainment for a run and does not claim that the workflow caused the external blog to be available or current.
